ABOUT.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack web developer. I currently work as a .NET Developer at Reliant Parking, building and maintaining web and mobile applications with .NET, C#, SQL Server, AWS and Vue.js.
Before that I built RESTful APIs for over 100,000 users at Pixzelle Studio, took an autonomous drone monitoring system to production at Inercy, and developed web systems for UABC.
